main_text.head: De φημὶ loquor.
INDICATIVVS.
Præsens.
main_text.p: φημί φής (cum acuto & subscripto) φησίDico. φατί. Dual. φατόν φατόν. Plu. φαμέν φατὲ φασί, Dor. φατὶ uel φαντὶ apud Pindarum passim.
main_text.head: Imperfectum seu Infinitum β.
main_text.p: ἔφλω ἔφης (uel ἔφησα secundū Iones, quiDicebam & dixi. frequenter secundis personis ἔφα subne- ctunt, οἴδας οἴδασα, & per Syncopen οἴ- δα) ἔφη.
ἔφατον ἐφάτλω uel ἔφητον. ἔφαμεν uel ἐφημεν ἔφατε ἔφασαν uel ἔφαν. Et abiecto augmento φλῶ φῆς φῆ.
Item ablato φ, λῶ, ῆς, ῆ, quod celebreDixi. est apud Homerum.
main_text.head: INDICATIVVS medǐj.
Præsens.
Imperfectum seu Infinitum ɛ.
main_text.p: A Ἰζω Ἰζημι, Præsens Indicatiui me- dǐ regulare Ἰζεμαι.Quæro.

page.notes: Greek and Latin words are printed with many accents and abbreviations; several Greek forms are uncertain due to the scan, notably the paradigms of φημί and ἵζημι, and the marginal "Dicebam" / "dixi" notes. Some Greek forms transcribed approximately.
